applies_to: Integra Metering CALEC ST III heating/cooling energy calculators with the BACnet MS/TP interface.
summary: The CALEC ST III is a heat and cooling energy calculator that pairs two temperature sensors with a flow meter. Its BACnet MS/TP interface reports energy, volume, mass, auxiliary counters, power, flows, hot/cold temperatures, temperature difference, density, a second power and flow channel and eight tariff registers as Analog Inputs, plus two commandable relay Binary Outputs. Which objects are present depends on the CALEC configuration.
notes: Object names follow the pattern AI-x-<description>; names are given as printed in the extended AI table (AI-1, AI-3 and AI-15 are printed without the second hyphen).
Units are writable per object from an allowed list (energy, volume, power, flow units); the PICS gives no default unit.
There is no AI 7. AI 16-25 (power 2, flow 2, tariff registers R1-R8) are new compared with the CALEC ST II list.
Object availability depends on the CALEC function (standard, mass, flow) and input types; see the availability table in the PICS.
Mass and mass flow are converted from metric tons to US short tons over BACnet.

source.title: CALEC ST III - BACnet MS/TP Protocol Implementation Conformance Statement

integration.summary: Set the MS/TP address and baud on the CALEC, then read energy, power, flow and the two temperatures. Check each AI's Units property since units are selectable.
setup: MS/TP master or slave, 9600-115200 baud; Max_Master default 127, Max_Info_Frames 1.
Device object name defaults to Calec ST III BACnet; vendor ID 431.
gotchas: Units are writable on each AI; changing them changes what the BMS reads.
